claim: AllReduce count is datatype elements and returns reduced arrays on every rank; ReduceScatter input requires rank count times recvcount.
Public all-reduce builds ncclInfo and enters common enqueue rather than choosing ring directly.
Enqueue checks communicator/revoked/readiness/arguments, appends task, updates opCount and completes an internal nested group scope.
Group end guarantees enqueueing rather than effective GPU completion; dependent work belongs after the outer group end.
Current CUDA device and communicator rank are separate identities established during rank initialization.
Bootstrap exchanges peer control information separately from payload transport connections and can add RAS observations.
Topology XML refreshes host hashes and discovers local GPU while other GPU information arrives through fusion.
Topology paths are recomputed after trimming and unavailable GPU P2P paths can route through CPU intermediate nodes.
Topology trimming retains the local reachable domain without changing communicator membership.
Communication graph channel and bandwidth fields are modeled search results, not measured payload throughput.
Graph search applies path/topology/budget constraints, XML override, NVLS gates and split-NVLink channel adjustment.
EnqueueRearchEnable defaults to zero; rawTaskAppend only runs when explicitly selected.
Enabled preparation order is pretuning, eligible common tuning, classification, then posttuning.
Active task scheduler calls doLaunches while separated scheduler calls remain commented future work.
Enabled group branch explicitly falls back to the current phased doLaunches and suppresses launch during simulation.
General plans bound nonpersistent output work to half the FIFO and drain collectives before P2P to preserve rank-consistent cuts.
Default ncclGetAlgoInfo reaches common tuning and distinguishes forced per-call errors from soft fallback and hard tuning failures.
Common tuning masks/validates candidates, accepts optional tuner cost updates, then selects modeled results/resources.
General tree model hard-disables non-AllReduce functions under its eligibility model.
Modeled tuning time combines latency aggregation, byte/bandwidth term, and FP8 precision preference where applicable.
Ring final reduced chunk belongs to ring-relative index; small tails align chunk count to 16 bytes divided by element size.
Ring reduction circulation and final distribution use different fused primitives, while tree follows parent/child roles.
Common kernel maps active blocks to channels and does not report aborted work as diagnostic completed progress.
Simple waits distinguish send credits from receive readiness over finite step slots and selected direct/FIFO modes.
LL pairs data with two generation flags, uses finite send credits and cleanup to protect flag wrap reuse.
LL layout assumptions include flags following data and contiguous socket receive or eight-byte atomic IB/RDMA writes.
LL128 has 128-byte lines with one of sixteen 64-bit elements reserved for a flag and designated flag-thread stores.
Transport selection tries canConnect/setup in candidate order; local P2P checks topology, network preference, device visibility and access.
SHM canConnect requires enabled policy, no network preference, matching host hash and matching shared-memory device identity.
Network plugin success with null isend/irecv request means no accepted request yet, requiring progress/retry.
NET send advances transmitted only for real accepted requests and returns credit after test completion and ordered FIFO reset.
NET receive completion can require conditional Simple/GDR visibility flush before GPU-ready tail publication.
Device communicator validates initializer, readiness/version/capability requirements and supports selected runtime-sized state.
Gin context count is a hint; strong and VA signal capability promises constrain later custom-kernel use.
Strong signal visibility covers preceding puts, while weak signal covers only its bundled put under the documented action contract.
Gin host setup filters active backends by requested type and signal capability and can try the next eligible setup candidate.
Ordinary registration can intentionally return success/null, and cache local/graph references retire transport registrations separately from allocation ownership.
Nonpersistent host plan callback uploads proxy work, starts proxy and enqueues reclaim without waiting there for all network requests.
Finalize, destroy, abort and revoke have distinct quiescence/failure contracts; failed outputs are not mathematically rolled back.
Async getter returns API status separately from communicator/proxy/Gin error output and linked group-job handling.
RAS platform implementation defaults enabled, passive diagnostics default disabled, and bootstrap explicitly tolerates RAS initialization failure.
Progress monitoring uses per-GPU workers and host counter mirrors that may be stale; it does not establish model tensor readiness.
Local P2P diagnostics compare deterministic remote write/read patterns and synchronize cleanup; no hardware run is claimed.
Contributed custom all-reduce checkAllEqual verifies its custom float4 outputs and cleanup destroys device resources/windows before communicator retirement.
README points to separate nccl-tests; its source bodies and runtime results are outside the inspected local baseline.
